shots.flux_frame: Massive dish array against a dense starfield, isolated outpost, teal-amber grade
shots.flux_prompt: An extreme wide anamorphic establishing shot of a massive deep-space radio dish array on an isolated lunar outpost, the primary subject occupying the lower third of frame against an infinite dense starfield. Practical amber work lights trace the dish scaffolding while cool teal nebula haze bleeds across the background, volumetric light shafts cutting through suspended dust. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with Panavision C-series anamorphic lenses at T2.8, 24mm, slow imperceptible dolly push. Interstellar-grade photorealism: teal shadow grade, warm amber highlights, fine film grain, gentle horizontal lens flare from a distant console beacon. Quiet, monumental stillness — no figures in frame, deep shadow falloff at frame edges, cinematic sci-fi documentary tone.

shots.flux_frame: Black background, ordered pair (a,b) plots as a dot on a grid, relabels to z=a+ib
shots.flux_prompt: A clean educational math visualization frame on pure black #000000 background: a single cyan-white glowing point plotted at coordinates (a,b) on a minimal Cartesian grid with thin grey axis lines. The label z = a + ib appears in crisp sans-serif white typography beside the point, soft cyan bloom on the dot, no decorative elements, no characters, no environment. Locked-off flat orthographic view, 16:9, high contrast, legibility-first graphic design. Style reference: 3Blue1Brown / Manim aesthetic — precise, luminous, scientific clarity. Subtle film grain at 5% opacity only to avoid flat digital look.
